_about: Фоны сцен: что это за место (ru) и описание для генератора картинок (en). Имя — то же, что в поле bg у сцен. Страницу с готовыми запросами собирает refs/tools/build_bg_page.py; он же проверяет, что описан каждый фон, который нужен сюжету. Фон рисуется без людей: середина спокойная, важное по краям. Поле now — какой старый фон показывается, пока своего рисунка нет.

bg_act0_void.en: an unfinished world before birth: a pale empty sky-space with half-built floating pieces of a medieval village — a roof without a house, a fence going nowhere, a staircase ending in the air — and faint turquoise construction lines connecting them

bg_act1_birth.en: the yard of a peasant cottage at dusk: a thatched half-timbered house with warm light in its small windows, a stone wall, a barrel and herb pots by the door, a cobbled path

bg_act1_first_word.en: the inside of a small peasant cottage at night, cosy and full of things: a big wooden cradle with a patchwork blanket standing on a sheepskin rug left of the centre, a table with a candle and clay jugs on the left, a whitewashed stove with pots at the back wall, a shelf with bowls, bunches of dried herbs and a cauldron hanging from the beam, a bench with folded cloth, a small window with stars, boots and a barrel by the open door on the right, a moonlit village outside; warm candle light inside, cool blue light from the door

bg_home_day.en: the inside of a peasant cottage by day: a big whitewashed stove, a heavy wooden table with benches, a small window with daylight, shelves with clay pots, a bucket by the door

bg_act1_bootcamp.en: a village parish school in a monastery yard: rows of rough wooden desks under an awning, a slate board on a post, rows of strokes, circles and crosses scratched in the dirt with pitchforks, a stone chapel wall behind

bg_church.en: the inside of a small wooden village church: a lectern with a very thick record book and a quill, candles, a stone font with water, simple benches

bg_act1_dig.en: a village vegetable garden behind a cottage: dug beds of dark earth, a row of turnips, a wooden fence, a shovel stuck in the ground, an apple tree in the corner

bg_goose_meadow.en: a green meadow by a pond at the edge of a village, a wooden goose pen with an open gate, white feathers on the grass

bg_barn_loft.en: the inside of an old barn: hay, tools hanging on the wall, one loose floorboard lifted to show a hiding place under it

bg_village_gate.en: the last fence gate at the edge of a village, the road beyond it running off into the fields, a bench by the gate, cottage roofs behind

bg_home_gate_dusk.en: the gate of a village cottage at sunset: a wooden gate in a low stone wall, a bench beside it, a dirt road running off into the fields, a thatched cottage on one side, an orange and purple evening sky

bg_act1_sandbox.en: a muddy play spot at the edge of a village: a big pile of mud and sand with half-built mud towers, small toy shovels lying around, a puddle, a fence and cottages behind

bg_well.en: a stone village well with a wooden roof on a small square, a bucket on a rope, a bench, coins glinting in the water

bg_rival_house.en: a rich village house decorated for a child's birthday: carved furniture, a table with a big cake and far too many gifts, garlands, a gilded scooter by the door

bg_act1_fair.en: a village fair on a green: colourful stalls with striped awnings, a merchant's cart full of goods, flags on a rope, barrels and baskets, the middle of the square empty

bg_act1_phone_curse.en: a hayloft at night lit by a cold turquoise glow coming from a piece of tree bark lying in the hay; moths circle the glow; a ladder and a small window with stars

bg_orchard.en: a nobleman's apple orchard behind a tall fence: neat rows of trees heavy with red apples, a gate with an iron knocker, a patch of nettles by the fence

bg_act1_windmill.en: an old wooden windmill on a hill above a village, its sails patched, a path leading up to the door, sacks of grain by the wall

bg_act1_military.en: a village square with a recruiting table: a banner on a pole, a table with scrolls and an inkwell, a pile of helmets and one big boulder, a notice board

bg_act1_road_lag.ru: Лесная дорога, где застрял Сэр Лаг
bg_act1_road_lag.en: a forest road with deep ruts, a milestone, a fallen signpost and a big oak; two boot-shaped dents in the mud, as if someone has stood here for a very long time

bg_act1_road_troll.en: a stone bridge over a small river with a wooden toll booth at its entrance, a striped barrier pole, a hand-made price board with pictures instead of letters

bg_act1_road_camp.en: a roadside camp at dusk: a small fire with a pot, a tent made from a cart cover, a log to sit on, a lute leaning against the log

bg_road_rain.en: a muddy road in the rain with a tax collector's booth and a barrier across the road, a barrel for measuring rain beside it, heavy grey clouds

bg_crossroads.en: a fork in the road: on the left a small gilded fortune-teller's tent with stars sewn on it, on the right a ditch with a rusty iron box standing beside it

bg_road_stone.en: a quiet roadside with an old mossy memorial stone standing in the grass, daisies around it, the road going on behind

bg_act3_road.en: a wide dusty highway between fields leading towards distant mountains, a milestone and a lonely tree, clouds casting flat shadows

bg_act2_customs.en: the main gate of a big medieval capital: huge wooden doors in a stone wall, a customs yard with a striped barrier, a guard's booth, a queue rope and a board divided into nine blank squares

bg_act2_guilds.en: a job-office hall seen straight on, with three very different doors spaced evenly along the back wall: on the left a heavy iron-bound door with crossed swords above it, in the middle a tall narrow wizard-tower door throwing small sparks, on the right a low cellar hatch with a lantern; the same framed portrait of a man seen from behind hangs above each door; between the doors a waiting bench, a notice board with blank paper slips, a queue rope on posts and a worn path in the stone floor leading to each door

bg_act2_guild_warriors.en: a guild hall of warriors: racks of spears and shields, straw training dummies, and a long table buried under piles of paper reports

bg_act2_guild_mages.en: a round room in a wizard tower: a big crystal ball on a pedestal showing a small hourglass, shelves of scrolls, tangled glowing threads running along the walls like cables, cups of cold tea

bg_act2_guild_thieves.en: a cellar of a thieves' guild set up like an office: a counting table with coin stacks and scales, a chalk board with a drawing of a turnip and an arrow going up, lockpicks hanging on the wall

bg_city_market.en: a market square of a medieval capital: stalls, sacks and barrels, and a big notice board on a post covered with small paper notes

bg_city_stairs.en: the entrance hall of a narrow town house: a steep wooden staircase with a tiny low door under it, a big key on a nail, a landlady's price board with pictures instead of letters

bg_city_room.en: a tiny room under a staircase: a slanted ceiling, a narrow bed, one shelf with a few things, a stool, a small window looking onto town roofs

bg_act2_city.en: a street of a medieval capital: tall narrow half-timbered houses, shop signs with pictures instead of letters, laundry lines between windows, cobblestones, the middle of the street empty

bg_act2_tinder.en: a matchmaker's cosy room: a round table covered with small portraits on birch bark laid out in rows, hearts cut from red cloth on the walls, a cage with carrier pigeons

bg_act2_tavern.en: a big tavern in the evening: long tables, benches, barrels behind the counter, candles stuck in bottles, one lonely table in the far corner

bg_act2_forge.en: a blacksmith's forge: a glowing furnace, an anvil, big bellows, pieces of armour and a cracked crystal ball waiting for repair on a shelf

bg_act2_lawyer.en: an old office with shelves up to the ceiling packed with wooden boxes with small blank tags, a clerk's high desk with a lamp, a ladder on wheels, dust in the light

bg_act2_hr.en: a gloomy stone office: a heavy desk with one candle and two folders on it, a hard stool in front of the desk, a barrel of water in the corner, a framed portrait of a man seen from behind on the wall

bg_act2_arena.en: a tournament arena: a sandy field with a wooden barrier down the middle, stands with flags, a royal box under a canopy

bg_act3_boardroom.en: a throne room arranged like a meeting room: a long table with a throne at its head, and a big board on the wall with a bar chart made of wooden blocks, one bar much taller than all the others

bg_act3_castle.en: a long palace corridor with a big wooden board on the wall covered with rows of small blank name plates, a halberd leaning nearby, a carpet runner

bg_act3_ball.en: a palace ballroom: chandeliers with candles, a chequered floor, long tables with fruit and pies along the walls, tall windows with curtains

bg_act3_scrum.en: a small palace room where a big map of the mountains is pinned to a board, covered with pins and strings, and a ring of footprints is worn into the floor around it

bg_event_kpi.en: a mountain roadside with an inspector's folding desk standing right on the road: a tally board with rows of notches, an hourglass, a stack of slates

bg_act3_glitch.en: a mountain road where the world has frozen: a bird hangs motionless in the sky, a waterfall stands still like glass, a piece of the sky is missing and shows wooden scaffolding and ropes behind it, a faint turquoise outline around the frozen things

bg_mountain_bridge.en: a rope-and-plank bridge over a deep mountain gorge, a small hollow under its near end with a stool and a lantern, snowy peaks behind

bg_last_village.en: the last small village before the mountains: a few stone houses along one street, the same wooden sign with a picture of a bed hanging on every house, mountains towering behind

bg_mountain_fork.en: a mountain crossroads with a wooden signpost with two blank arrows: one path climbs to a dark cave mouth, the other goes down into the valley; a flat stone to sit on

bg_act3_cave.en: a huge cave full of gold coins and chests, cold light falling from a crack above, a worn hollow in the gold where a dragon usually lies, old shed scales in a far corner

bg_act3_cafe.en: a small cosy roadside coffee house: a wooden counter with clay cups, a big oven with a scorch mark above it, sacks of coffee beans, a window with mountains

bg_goblin_loan.en: a tiny loan stall squeezed between two houses: a counter with a big iron-bound box, a scale, a stack of blank contracts with red seals, a cold turquoise lantern

bg_hr_shop.en: a heavenly waiting office among clouds: a counter window with a small bell, a ticket post with a blank plate and no writing, rows of empty benches, filing cabinets fading into the clouds, a cold turquoise glow
